== Purpose ==
Table attribute snippet used by '''pdxparse''' output. It is transcluded
''inside'' a wikitable's opening line, not as ordinary content:

<pre>
{| class="mildtable" {{buffer}}
</pre>

which expands to

<pre>
{| class="mildtable" cellspacing="2" cellpadding="5"
</pre>

== Notes ==
* There must be no newline or category link inside <code><nowiki><includeonly></nowiki></code>, or the table opening line will break.
* If the wiki styles table padding through <code>MediaWiki:Common.css</code> instead, this template can be left empty rather than deleted; pdxparse output still transcludes it and an empty expansion is harmless.
